item.title: Costa Rican authorities investigate killing of a US citizen in an apparent robbery
item.description: Costa Rican authorities are investigating the killing of a U.S. citizen in what they describe as an apparent robbery.

item.title: Guatemala ends emergency powers after a monthlong crackdown sparked by 10 police killings
item.description: Guatemala has ended its monthlong state of emergency after deadly attacks on police pushed President Bernardo Arévalo to seek special powers against gangs.

item.title: Australia won't repatriate 34 women and children from Syria
item.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says his government will not repatriate from Syria a group of 34 women and children with alleged ties to the Islamic State group.

item.title: Shares fall in Japan, while most Asian markets are shut for Lunar New Year
item.description: Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 index has fallen, while most markets in Asia are closed for Lunar New Year holidays.

item.title: Nate Heise hits go-ahead 3-pointer in No. 6 Iowa State's 70-67 win over No. 2 Houston
item.description: Nate Heise hit a go-ahead 3-pointer and Tamin Lipsey came up with an offensive rebound in the final seconds to cap No. 6 Iowa State's rally in a 70-67 victory over Big 12 leader and second-ranked Houston on Monday night.

item.title: Ex-NRL player Matt Utai shot in alleged drive-by outside his Sydney home
item.description: Former New Zealand rugby league international Matt Utai has undergone surgery after an alleged drive-by shooting outside his home in southwestern Sydney, Australian media has reported.
